text: When did the Shanti Bahini insurgency begin? Banglapedia notes armed operations beginning in early 1976 in the Chittagong Hill Tracts.
How did the insurgency phase formally end? Through the Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord signed on 2 December 1997 between the government and PCJSS.
The CHT conflict left a long afterlife in questions of land, recognition, and implementation.
